title: Who may reserve a Safe Deposit Box, and where?
content:
## Scope

This policy covers reserving a box in the Safe Deposit Boxes line: the minimum age of the customer, the branch at which a size may be reserved, what a reservation records, and the bank's position on insuring box contents.

## Policy clause

1. **Age.** The customer must be at least 18 years old, in whole years, on the reservation date. The age is judged from the date of birth held in the bank's customer record for that customer, before the reservation is recorded; the customer's statement of their age is not the basis.
2. **Branch.** A size can be reserved only at a branch where that size is installed in the vault.
3. **What a reservation is.** A reservation puts the customer on the waitlist of that branch for the size reserved. It is recorded in waitlisted status with nothing owed, and the reservation date becomes the customer's waitlist priority date.
4. **Contents insurance.** The bank does not insure the contents of any box. Questions about insuring contents are referred to the customer's own insurer.

## Values by box size

| Official box size | Youngest age at which a customer may lease | Contents insured by the bank |
|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 18 years | No |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 18 years | No |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 18 years | No |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 18 years | No |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 18 years | No |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 18 years | No |

## Entry conditions as a checklist

| Condition | Basis | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Age on the reservation date | Date of birth in the customer record | 18 or older in whole years |
| Size installed at the chosen branch | The branch's installed sizes | The size is installed there |

## Age boundary cases

The dates are hypothetical.

| Customer's 18th birthday | Reservation date | Age on the reservation date | Age condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 September | 12 September of the same year | 18 | Met |
| 13 September | 12 September of the same year | 17 | Not met |
| 12 September of the prior year | 12 September | 19 | Met |

A customer whose 18th birthday falls on the reservation date meets the condition, because the requirement is "at least" 18.

## Basis Q&A

**The customer says they turned 18 last month, but the record shows a later birth date. Which governs?** The date of birth in the bank's customer record.

**Can a customer reserve a size at a branch whose vault does not have that size installed?** No. A size can be reserved only at a branch where it is installed.

**Is anything owed when a reservation is recorded?** No. A new reservation is recorded with nothing owed.

**Does the bank insure what the customer keeps in the box?** No. The bank does not insure box contents; the customer is referred to their own insurer.
